summary: This joint resolution blocks the EPA rule titled 'Review of Final Rule Reclassification of Major Sources as Area Sources Under Section 112 of the Clean Air Act' (89 Fed. Reg. 73293) from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a Congressional Review Act resolution nullifying an EPA regulatory action. It contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budgets.
The bill addresses only the status of an EPA rule under the Clean Air Act and has no tax-related content.
No provisions touch on healthcare policy, insurance, or medical regulation.
The legislation is unrelated to firearms or Second Amendment issues.
No connection to immigration, border policy, or citizenship.
The bill does not address reproductive rights or abortion access.
No military, defense, or national security spending provisions appear in the text.

This is a CRA disapproval resolution that would nullify an EPA rule issued under Section 112 of the Clean Air Act concerning reclassification of emission sources. By removing the rule's force and effect, the bill directly limits the scope of federal environmental regulation on air pollution and emissions. This matches the +1 pole of the scale.
No welfare, entitlement, or social services provisions are present.
The bill contains nothing related to schools, education funding, or school choice.
No drug enforcement, decriminalization, or controlled-substances language.
Unrelated to policing, sentencing, or criminal procedure.
No trade, tariff, or globalization provisions.
The resolution does not address deficits, debt ceiling, or fiscal policy.
No provisions concerning LGBTQ legal protections or related civil rights.
The bill is silent on foreign assistance or international aid.
No election administration, voting access, or campaign finance content.
Unrelated to technology regulation or data privacy.
No labor, union, or workplace regulation provisions.
The legislation does not engage with religious exemptions or anti-discrimination law.
